feeds_shape_check.name: feeds_shape_check
feeds_shape_check.value:
("feeds"."kind" = 'subreddits' and cardinality("feeds"."subreddits") > 0 and "feeds"."query" is null)
        or ("feeds"."kind" = 'search' and "feeds"."query" is not null and "feeds"."subreddits" is null)

job_post_analyses_budget_check.name: job_post_analyses_budget_check
job_post_analyses_budget_check.value: "job_post_analyses"."budget_min" is null or "job_post_analyses"."budget_max" is null or "job_post_analyses"."budget_min" <= "job_post_analyses"."budget_max"

profile_experience_start_check.name: profile_experience_start_check
profile_experience_start_check.value:
("profile_experience"."start_year" is null or "profile_experience"."start_year" between 1950 and 2100)
        and ("profile_experience"."start_month" is null or ("profile_experience"."start_year" is not null and "profile_experience"."start_month" between 1 and 12))

profile_experience_end_check.name: profile_experience_end_check
profile_experience_end_check.value:
("profile_experience"."end_year" is null or "profile_experience"."end_year" between 1950 and 2100)
        and ("profile_experience"."end_month" is null or ("profile_experience"."end_year" is not null and "profile_experience"."end_month" between 1 and 12))

profile_experience_current_check.name: profile_experience_current_check
profile_experience_current_check.value: not "profile_experience"."is_current" or ("profile_experience"."end_year" is null and "profile_experience"."end_month" is null)
